name: io.github.rclone-ui/rclone
description: MCP server for the Rclone RC API, with selectable toolsets.

environmentVariables.name: RCLONE_URL
environmentVariables.description: A running rclone to use. Without it, rclone-mcp starts its own

environmentVariables.name: RCLONE_USER
environmentVariables.description: HTTP Basic Auth username for RCLONE_URL

environmentVariables.name: RCLONE_PASS
environmentVariables.description: HTTP Basic Auth password for RCLONE_URL

environmentVariables.name: RCLONE_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated list of toolsets to enable (default, all, or specific: core, config, operations, sync, jobs, vfs, mount, dangerous, etc.)

environmentVariables.name: RCLONE_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to expose only tools that change nothing and return no credentials

environmentVariables.name: RCLONE_MCP_MAX_OUTPUT
environmentVariables.description: The most characters of output a tool call returns. Defaults to 100000
